entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, VeloFit agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello, Alex. I'm a bit... overwhelmed. I bought a helmet a while back and I think I need to return it? I'm just not sure what to do. The website was a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with your order number?
Yes, I have it here somewhere... it's VF-8675309. I hope this is right. I never even took it out of the packaging, the box is still unopened.

Thank you, I've pulled up your order. I see the AeroLite helmet, delivered 69 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. It's just the color. It looked different on my computer, and it doesn't match my bike at all. It's a nice helmet, just... not for me. I feel so silly about it. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you. It's no trouble at all. I've checked our return policy, and since the item was delivered within the last 90 days and is still in its original condition, you are eligible for a full refund. I can process that for you right now.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was stuck with it. What do I do next?

I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file as we speak. You just need to attach that to the shipping box and drop it off. Also, I see you're one of our VIP members. We want to make sure you have gear you love. Your safety is our top priority, and that includes feeling confident in what you wear. I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Wow, you did? That's so kind of you! Thank you, Alex. You've been a great help.
It's my pleasure. We'll process your refund as soon as we receive the helmet. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you so much!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
